messages.text: Does the h15, come with Harlo OS?
Read the harlo h15 dual page

Raland, I need to correct what I told you on the 10th. Please don't buy the H15 expecting Harlo OS on it. Harlo OS work has been paused for every miner, so we can't promise it on any unit right now.

Our team is working on something to replace it. They'll share news once it's ready, but I don't have a date or a name for it yet.

The H15 is $799 and ships November 30, 2026. Do you want me to find out exactly which firmware it ships with before you decide?
Handed to the team · The H15 firmware isn't in the product facts. Pre-purchase question from a repeat

I've asked JD which firmware the H15 ships with. The team is offline right now. They pick this up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer goes to your email, (email hidden)

If you want an answer sooner, you can post in our Discord and mention @nullhashrate (that's JD): https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

The H15 ships November 30, so you have time to hear back before you decide.
Isn’t it part of a bundle?
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 bundle

It's both. The H15 Dual is sold on its own for $799. It's also in the Harlo Duo Pack with a B30 for $1,599.

The Duo Pack page still says both units run Harlo OS. That line is out of date, and it's the one I quoted you on the 10th. I'm sorry for passing it on. Harlo OS is paused, so neither unit in the pack should be bought expecting it.

JD's answer on which firmware the H15 ships with covers the pack too. Do you want the bundle details while you wait?

The Harlo Duo Pack is $1,599, which is $99 less than buying the two units separately ($1,698).

The B30 does 30 TH/s at 485 W, 24 TH/s at 350 W, or 18 TH/s at 230 W. The H15 Dual mines Bitcoin at 15 TH/s and Dogecoin/Litecoin at 1.08 GH/s at the same time, drawing about 500 W.

Both have built-in power supplies, and each runs at about 50 dB. They connect over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi or Ethernet. Together they draw about 985 W at full power.

The page doesn't give a ship date for the pack, so I'll find that out before you decide.

Here's the link: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/harlo-duo-pack-b30-h15-dual
